name: Lapis Idocrase
original_name: ラピス・アイドクレーズ
source:
"This training is a big chance for me."

2nd year student at a magic school.
The type of person who can't leave people in trouble alone, she has an overflowing determined spirit.
She has four excellent older brothers.
